confirm.remove_locale: Remove this locale? Its translations and content tables will be deleted.

hints.alias: UI-string serving alias - requests for this locale render the target locale's strings
hints.locale_code: BCP 47 locale code to add (e.g. de-at)

ui.activate_locale_hint: Already-supported locales - runs their prepared translations and marks them active.
ui.add_locale_hint: Adds the locale to config, seeds its translations and clones content tables (generator add-locale).
ui.available_locales_hint: Curated translations already exist on disk for these locales - add one with a single click (added to config only, not made active).
ui.busy: Processing — the page will refresh when complete.
ui.locales_description: Manage config/supported_locales.ts - locale codes, display names, aliases, active list and default.
ui.locales_manage_hint: Add a locale to create its translations + content tables, or edit the config below directly.
ui.remove_selected_hint: Removes the selected locales - their translations and content tables are deleted.
ui.save_hint: Saves straight to config/supported_locales.ts. Reload routes to apply.
